CustomField.formula: if(Discount_Percent__c > 0, 'Discount' & text(Discount_Percent__c) & '%', '') & if( ADM_Fee_Waived_Percentage__c > 0, ' Adm Fee Waived' & text(ROUND(ADM_Fee_Waived_Percentage__c * 100,2)) & '%', '') & if( HomeMaintenanceWaivedYears__c > 0, ' HomeMaintenanceWaiverYears' & text(HomeMaintenanceWaivedYears__c), '') & if(Rebate_Percentage__c > 0, ' Rebate' & text(Rebate_Percentage__c * 100) & '%', '')
CustomField.label: All Offers
